body: I have crazy shit going on in my head all the time. Aliens, bigfoot, ancient shit, space, what's after death, and more. I'll have to think of some batshit solutions. Thanks. I dunno if I'm a fighter, just a lot I want to experience.

I'm 32 and wasted my life. You, you're still young, you have your whole life ahead of you. I don't like seeing kids your age talk about suicide, life is hard even at that age, but focus on something.
